about: Roof takeoff rules extending content-v3/takeoff-rules.json (roof.*). Same buy rules: counted items n+round(n*waste); area items ceil(q*(1+w)/unit); lumber stock 8/10/12/14/16/20 ft, split >20 ft. Reference implementation: reference/roof-reference.mjs + run-worked-example.mjs. All $ EXAMPLE.

symbols.kh: equal-pitch hip/valley factor = sqrt(2+(p/12)^2) per ft of common run

geometry.heel_HAP_in: d/cos(theta) - s*tan(theta)   (top of rafter above plate at the wall's outside face)
geometry.sloped_area: plan_area * k  (per-face k for unequal pitches: sum faces)

valley.equal_pitch_equal_heights: true = run*kh where run = half-span (+ eave overhang to the eave junction), plan at 45 deg
valley.general: valley line where zNew + u*pn/12 = zExist + a*pe/12; foot = max(new eave edge, existing eave edge); tip at ridge u=W/2, aTip=(zRidge-zExistAtWall)*12/pe; plan=hypot(du,da), true=hypot(plan, du*pn/12)
valley.count: 2 for a gable tie-in; 2 per inside corner otherwise

tie_in_height.shed_under_eave: maxHighRoofTop = eaveUnderside + floorDrop - flashingClearIn/12 ; maxHighPlate = maxHighRoofTop - (HAP+sheath)/12

items.qty: stations = floor(L*12/oc)+1 per slope; gable pairs x2; shed x1

items.size: one size deeper than commons (R802.4.3 'not less than cut end')

items.qty: per side: stations from valley/hip foot to tip at oc
items.stock: pair long+short into one stock length

items.qty: ridge_length split into stock (splice over a rafter pair)
items.size: board: one size deeper than rafter (content-v3); beam: LVL per engineer (price lvl_175x1178_*)

items.qty: 1 per rafter per bearing wall (gable: 1; shed: 2)

items.info: 16d per heel from Table R802.5.2(1) by pitch/oc/span/snow (e.g. 4:12 @24, 24 ft col, 50 psf -> 13)

items.qty: content-v3 rule over each gable triangle 0.5*W*rise (2 for gable, 1 for gable_into_roof)
cross-layer: walls layer adds a non-exterior bearing wall along attachToExistingWallId at the needed plate height
1 board = L, LedgerLOK 5 in 2 per 16 in (guidance)

items.thickness: pickSheathing(oc, snow): <=allowable live load Table R503.2.1.1(1); EXAMPLE: 19/32 OSB at 24 in for 50 psf (cheaper than 15/32 ply)

items.qty: sheets*2 (one per bay per sheet at 24 in oc, guidance)

items.courses: reqSlopeIn=(ohIn+24)*k (>=36 in if p>=8); courses=1 if <=36 else 1+ceil((req-36)/33)
items.note: content-v3 iceBarrierWidthFt=3 under-counts with a 12 in overhang (needs 37.9 in at 4:12) - fix

items.plus: existing-side valley reroof strip valleyLf*2 ft

items.qty: ceil(valleyLf*1.10/9.5) (10 ft with 6 in laps), 24 in wide
1 per roof-to-wall line ending at an eave
per slope: ceil((L+2ohr)/coverageFt) panels of length >= rafter slope length (+2 in overhang), coverage UNVERIFIED (5V ~2 ft, SM-Rib ~3 ft)
ceil(ventedRidgeLf/4) (stop 12 in short of ends and of any tie-in)

items.nfa_check: req = atticFloorSf*144/150 (or /300); half low, half high

items.qty: 2 per rafter bay at vented eaves
per eave run, prefer 16 ft pieces then 10 ft
1 per eave run <=35 ft (guidance UNVERIFIED); length eave-to-grade; 3 elbows each
per object + curb lumber + step flashing kit
floor(L*12/oc)+1 commons + 2 gable-end trusses; girder/valley set for tie-ins

content_v3_corrections: iceBarrierWidthFt=3 is too narrow for 12 in overhangs (Montana R905.1.2 needs eave->24 in inside wall = 37.9 in along slope at 4:12) -> use courses rule
Roof sheathing 7/16 (24/16) is only rated 40 psf live at 24 in o.c.; in Montana snow use 15/32+ or 16 in spacing
Ridge one-size-up rule OK for boards; cathedral needs beam
